summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend validation of the new Intelligent Affiliate Product Widget engine (affiliate_engine.py). 11/11 backend pytest tests pass — admin auth gating (401/403/200), config shape (7 retailers, all fields), partial-merge PUT (amazon tag set without wiping siblings), /posts shape, /regenerate returning AI list, /backfill queue, public /materials (all 7 retailers per item, amazon tag=diyhomie-20 injected, blacklist excluded, priority-ordered), public /html (aff-wrap + multiple aff-btn with rel='nofollow sponsored'), and email-engine smoke regression. Frontend: /admin loads, 'Affiliate Widget' nav (admin-nav-affiliate) opens module, all three tabs (aff-tab-settings/retailers/posts) work, all 7 retailer cards render in Retailers tab, aff-backfill + aff-regen-{slug} buttons present in Articles tab. /blog/patch-a-small-drywall-hole shows the AffiliateWidget card 'Materials & Tools Needed' with all 7 retailer buttons per item across all categories. No deprecated Expo packages introduced by this engine.
critical_code_review_comments: affiliate_engine.py is well-scoped (~370 lines), uses async DB calls, excludes mongo _id, no hardcoded URLs, links built at read-time so config changes apply instantly without regeneration — good design.
Per-retailer merge in PUT /config is implemented correctly (line 319-324: spreads existing retailer fields under new ones), confirmed via test_partial_update_merges.
AffiliateModule.tsx uses Pressable + StyleSheet + Text correctly; all interactive elements have testIDs (aff-tab-*, aff-backfill, aff-regen-*).
Optional minor: PostsTab in AffiliateModule swallows backfill errors silently (line 135) — consider Alert on failure.
seed_data_creation: Set config: amazon.affiliate_tag=diyhomie-20, preferred_brands=[DeWalt,Milwaukee], blacklist cleared after test. Triggered AI regenerate on slug 'patch-a-small-drywall-hole' which now has source='ai' shopping_list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Affiliate engine fully validated. Admin login at /auth (toggle to login mode first via auth-toggle-mode), then /admin → admin-nav-affiliate. Two existing blog slugs: patch-a-small-drywall-hole, replace-a-kitchen-faucet-moen-adler-87233. Public endpoints /api/blog/{slug}/materials and /html require no auth.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All 12 acceptance criteria from the review request pass: auth gating, config shape, partial-merge, posts listing, regenerate→ai, backfill queue, public /materials with 7 retailers + amazon tag + blacklist + priority order, /html SSR with aff-wrap + aff-btn + rel='nofollow sponsored', auto-gen on creation (via maybe_create_blog_post wiring confirmed in server.py:1817-1818), admin frontend module with tabs/retailers/backfill/regen testIDs, and in-app blog reader AffiliateWidget rendering.
